claim_as_stated: 在所述 canonical conformal 与 metric-measure companion、Brownian/LQG输入下，对n-edge critical spherical FK–Ising multimap，包含loops/multiplicities的attempt-rate1全边walk以corner law deg(v)/(2n)为stationary measure。用确定性diameter normalization a_n缩放距离、用n加速时间，metric-measure空间、全部ordered eigenvalues n lambda_n,j（含重数与+infty padding）、heat trace Tr exp(ntL_n)联合收敛至同一个ordinary unit-area sqrt(3)-quantum sphere的intrinsic LQG metric、LBM half-Dirichlet-form spectrum和heat trace；谱topology为逐坐标，heat trace于每个[delta,T]一致。文中证明 conductivity和clock常数均为1；continuum form closable、constants为唯一zero mode、compact resolvent、每个t>0heat trace有限。
proof_architecture: 先精确核对能量与测度：raw E=sum_e(df)^2对应B_n=−2nL_n，half continuum form对应A_h=B_h/2；flag surface与全部incidence使primal/dual及corner measure在同一canonical coordinate比较。

把finite incidence record任意measurable numerical optimization加入companions protected conditional-law array。resampling weights只改macroscopic input而保留conditional output kernel；local AC、subprobability entropy和germ triviality允许在ordinary/sphere/selected views之间转移概率一结论，保留真实高度与单位。

若raw annulus EL的quantiles坍塌，选record-low subsequence、向后固定offset rows。aligned annuli给density budget；cheap flows的平均arclength非零且绝对连续。tangent crossing germ在各方向/位置确定且处处存在；同一flag sphere上的横向primal与纵向dual families强迫paired edge相交，1≤tau·tau*≤C rho_k→0矛盾。得固定test的正EL、bounded-energy cutoff与bounded squared-traffic circuits。

用countable cell constrained quadratic infima建立locally-uniform relaxation与uniform recovery，cutoff gluing给Radon quadratic energy。circuits/partitions给Sobolev上下界；polarization得到matrix densityA，local germ+translation+rotation使A=kI。exact FK duality给k_p=k_d；真实primal boundary circuits上的complementary mixed conductances乘积恒为1，其square limits给k_p k_d=1，故k=1。

point-source voltage用super/sublevel paths与clipped-energy bound取得pole外局部bounds；harmonic compactness和recovery replacement消去energy defect并给harmonicity。改变source值的annular variation精确给flux±1；one-sided singularity bounds排除高阶pole，得到(2pi)^−1 log cross-ratio four-point limit。

谱compactness需全离散尺度：address graph两色rank对occupancy的charge与entropy count、one-base wide-range credit排除所有尺度rank cycles。acyclic finite view经ordinary completion和post-output anchors的紧绝对连续转移给available circuit flows。weighted-level selection统一所有levels，reachable packing控制支持overlap；cover boundary oscillation与parent-child比较望远镜到singleton，得block error≤C2^(−7j/10)E。把最小充分level作为一个数值readout转移至sphere，避免仅有逐个fixed-level估计。

quantum area的uniform upper/lower polynomial small-ball bounds构造injective Sobolev trace和closed regular LBM form，double-centered round logarithmic Green kernel是raw form的HS inverse。corner time把离散L2放入同一H；有限cover的priority block averages提供rankO(2^j) linear approximants及strong energy compactness，min–max给nu_n,i≥c i^(7/10)。

four-point limit只识别kernel的double differences。若最大inverse eigenvalue发散，先除以operator norm，strong compactness+square-summable tail给HS极限norm1，但double differences趋0且double centering使其必0，矛盾。再得未归一化HS convergence。ordered eigenvalues和positive-time uniformly summable heat tails随之收敛；共同coordinate中的distance graph与measure convergence转GHP，最终joint subsequence criterion完成。

construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对于带有限degree/bandwidth的Q(Z)线性化，可先求每步操作的真实support propagation上界，再选足够大padding或cyclic parameter防止wraparound路径相撞；这样能把formal coefficient分离写成显式有限阈值而非generic-position口号。
construction_ideas.missing_step: paper前提是一个既有matrix identity的rootword，结果不是任意matrix的cyclic/truncated determinants相等。pi仍需实际非零minor；padding b线性依赖m·d可能造成巨大column cost，须重新优化。

construction_ideas.idea: 两条独立的coprime annihilation约束消除不可见central ambiguity，且参数顺序防止循环。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: z同时在所有degree truncation kernels中，positive grading分离matrix entries；先由固定原representative得W_z(C_b)=1对所有足够大b，再选odd phase L越过这个固定阈值，最后才以高degree kernel重写z的long-entry representative。relative kernel另有2-power torsion。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 同一homomorphism W_z(C_L)既由原word给1，又由long-entry phase relocation给z^L；与z^(2^a)=1的coprimality推出z=1。关键W_z只依赖element，重写representative不能改变预先chosen阈值。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 可在pi determinant方案中明确分离形式对象、representation及参数：先从固定Q(Z)构造决定一个uniform degree/height阈值，再选evaluation prime/modulus/columns，最后允许等价变换。若需消除一个quotient看不见的obstruction，可寻找第二个arithmetically independent certificate而不是默认matrix shadow faithful。
construction_ideas.missing_step: coprime torsion论证针对group element，不是一般integer determinant上下界；需建立真正的两个约束及同一对象不变性。不能用两个不同候选的nonzero/upper-bound证书拼接。

construction_ideas.idea: ordered matroid frames可用删除与prefix过滤建立integral exactness，但两种independence的共同bases需另证。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: finite labeled nonzero vector collection span dimensionm；labels可对应相同vector但保留distinct，chains是所有ordered linearly independent tuples、alternating deletion，所有orderings独立而非orientation识别。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 删一个label v；relative tuples按v前的prefix length过滤，associated graded suffix是quotient vector space上的ordered independence complex及degree shift。归纳给≤m−2 exact；若v是coloop，prepend v chain homotopy处理剩余case。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Q(Z)的rowrank或候选columns若形成真实linear matroid，可用这种ordered-frame结构组织spare-coordinate/exchange certificates，避免把重复signature occurrences合并导致rank或multiplicity信息丢失。两linear representations若common-basis complex有可证明的相应exactness，或可支持更系统的exchange构造。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 两个matroids的共同independent sets通常不构成matroid；paper的single-linear-matroid exactness不能直接推出common basis存在。必须先证明实际Q(Z)independence及所需intersection条件，且任何extra columns需计columnheight/quadratic occupancy。
